sentences.text:
Having heard the learned counsel on both sides, we dispose of the writ appeal with the following directions;
2. The Arbitrator appointed under the National Highway Authority Act is hereby directed to consider the application for enhancement of compensation filed by the appellant under Section 3G of the National Highway Act in accordance with law.
The decision shall be taken as early as possible.
The writ appeal is disposed of as above.

Sd/-
